caption:
The Hockey India League is back in January. With two fewer men's teams.

Hockey India confirmed on Thursday that the 2026/27 season starts in the first week of January. Six men's teams and four women's teams this time. Last season the men's league had eight.

The player auction is on December 7 in New Delhi. Men's teams can spend up to Rs 4 crore each and women's teams Rs 2 crore. Base prices are Rs 2 lakh, Rs 5 lakh or Rs 10 lakh.

Players from the Ranchi Royals men's team and the Governing Council team go into the auction. More players in the pool and fewer teams bidding could mean bargains.

Will a smaller league make the HIL better? Tell us below.

Via Hockey India, reported by RevSportz, myKhel and India.com. 2025-26 teams via Wikipedia.
